title: 第3章 做什么选择全都要第4章 半个月气血境二层
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
张宿忽然笑了，做什么选择？
他又不是没有贡献点。
既然两门都是90%以上契合度，那就全都要！
如果两门剑法能圆满，那就能增加两点契合值。
这可是能增加契合值的功法。
两门算什么？
应该多多益善！
不过，人的精力是有限的。
先选定两门剑法，等以后再酌情挑选一些其他武技。
张宿当即去找传功阁长老兑换两门剑法。
“嗯？”
“一下子兑换两门剑法？”
“对，请长老成全。”
长老眉头一皱：“九影剑法与三重浪，虽然算不上顶尖剑法，但亦属上乘剑法。九影剑法主要练的是速度，以快闻名。而三重浪，则是首重力量，一重比一重强，以力压人。”
“这两门剑法，风马牛不相及，你确定都要兑换？”
长老的见识自然不凡。
也知道这两门剑法的特点，完全是两种风格。
一下子兑换两种风格剑法的弟子，还是相当罕见的。
“是，弟子确定兑换。”
张宿朝着长老一拜。

“好，一共六百贡献点。”
长老也就不再多说什么了，毕竟，该提醒的已经提醒了。
张宿兑换了两门剑法，他当即走进了修炼室，翻开两门剑法。
仔细查看两门剑法内容后，张宿知道，长老的提醒是对的。
这的确是两门风格不同的剑法。
可是，九影剑法契合度高达93%，而三重浪契合度也有91%，的确是都符合张宿的要求。
“那就试一试。”
张宿以前没有练剑，自身自然也就没有携带剑器。
不过，传功阁的修炼室内，各种兵器都有。
他抽出了一柄归元派制式长剑。
张宿脑海中立刻浮现出了九影剑法。
下一刻，张宿就仿佛本能一般，开始练习九影剑法。
刚开始，还比较中规中矩。
可随着时间推移，张宿的剑一剑比一剑快。
“咻咻咻”。
不知道过了多久，张宿一剑刺出，居然出现了三道剑影。
而且，这三道剑影，每一道几乎都一模一样。
这也不是什么幻术。
这三道剑影，其实都是真的。
当速度快到了一定的地步，就会出现剑影。

“一剑三影，这是九影剑法小成了……”
张宿很震惊。
这就小成了？
他记得很清楚，灵蛇拳，他练了整整一年。
而且契合度也不低，达到了81%的契合度。
content_en:
Zhang Su suddenly smiled, what choice should I make?
It's not like he has no contributions.
Since both doors are more than 90% compatible, I want them both!
If the two swordsmanships can be perfected, two points of compatibility will be added.
This is a technique that can increase the compatibility value.
What's two doors?
The more the merrier!
However, human energy is limited.
Choose two sword skills first, and then choose some other martial arts as appropriate.
Zhang Su immediately went to the elder of Chuan Gong Pavilion to exchange two sword techniques.
"Huh?"
"Exchanging two sword skills at once?"
"Yes, elder, please grant me permission."
The elder frowned: "Although the Nine Shadows Sword Technique and the Threefold Wave are not top-notch swordsmanships, they are still excellent swordsmanship. The Nine Shadows Sword Technique mainly focuses on speed and is famous for its speed. The Threefold Wave is the first level of strength. Each one is stronger than the other, and it can overwhelm people with its strength."
"These two sword skills are completely unrelated to each other. Are you sure you want to exchange them?"
The elder's knowledge is naturally extraordinary.
I also know that the characteristics of these two swordsmanship are completely different styles.
It is quite rare for a disciple to switch to two styles of swordsmanship at once.
"Yes, disciple is sure to redeem."
Zhang Su bowed to the elder.
"Okay, a total of 600 contribution points."
The elder said nothing more. After all, what needed to be reminded has been reminded.
Zhang Su exchanged two sword techniques. He immediately walked into the training room and opened the two sword techniques.
After carefully checking the contents of the two sword techniques, Zhang Su knew that the elder's reminder was right.
These are indeed two swordsmanships with different styles.
However, the compatibility of the Nine Shadows Sword Technique is as high as 93%, and the compatibility of the Triple Wave is also 91%, which indeed meets Zhang Su's requirements.
"Then give it a try."
Zhang Su had never practiced swordsmanship before, so he naturally did not carry a sword.
However, there are all kinds of weapons in the training room of Chuangong Pavilion.
He drew out a Guiyuan Sect standard long sword.
The Nine Shadow Sword Technique immediately appeared in Zhang Su's mind.
The next moment, Zhang Su started practicing the Nine Shadows Sword Technique as if by instinct.
At the beginning, it was quite satisfactory.
But as time went by, Zhang Su's sword became faster and faster.
"Boooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo much."
I don't know how long it took, but Zhang Su thrust out his sword, and three sword shadows appeared.
Moreover, each of these three sword shadows is almost identical.
This isn't some illusion either.
These three sword shadows are actually real.
When the speed reaches a certain level, a sword shadow will appear.
"One sword and three shadows, this is the completion of the Nine Shadows Sword Technique..."
Zhang Su was shocked.
Is this a small success?
He remembered clearly the Spiritual Snake Fist, which he had been practicing for a whole year.
And the fit is not low, reaching 81% fit.
